note: The second half of the stress set: 54 more questions on the same 22-table schema, six per category in the same nine categories as questions_hard.json, written after the first set had shown where the models struggle. Used together with the first set (126 questions) to give the quantization comparison more statistical power.

questions.question: Which warehouse shipped the most orders to customers located in the warehouse's own region? Show the warehouse name and the number of such shipments.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT w.wh_nm, COUNT(*) AS n FROM shipment s JOIN warehouse w ON w.wh_id = s.wh_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = s.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = w.region_cd GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY n DESC, w.wh_nm LIMIT 1
questions.tests: join condition between two region columns

questions.question: For each promotion, what is the total value of the USD orders it was applied to? Show the promotion code and the total.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.promo_cd, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_promo op JOIN promo p ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = op.ord_id WHERE o.currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd
questions.tests: bridge table with a currency filter

questions.question: Which customers have an order that was paid with a gift card and shipped by DHL? Show each customer name once.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_nm FROM payment p JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = p.ord_id JOIN shipment s ON s.ord_id = o.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE p.method_cd = 'GC' AND s.carrier_cd = 'DHL'

questions.question: How many units of each product category were ordered by customers in the Gold tier? Show the category code and the units.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.categ_cd, SUM(l.qty) FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = l.sku WHERE c.tier_cd = 'G' GROUP BY p.categ_cd

questions.question: Which employees are assigned to tickets raised by Platinum customers? Show the employee name and the number of such tickets.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.emp_nm, COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt t JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = t.assigned_emp_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'P' GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_nm
questions.tests: assignee is on the ticket, tier on the customer

questions.question: What is the average lead time in days of the primary suppliers of the products in the kitchen category? Round to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(ps.lead_days), 1) FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = ps.sku WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 AND p.categ_cd = 'KIT'

questions.question: For each customer in the AP region who has placed orders, show the id and total of their most recent order (break ties on the date by the higher order id). Order by customer id.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT o.cust_id, o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.cust_id ORDER BY o.ord_dt DESC, o.ord_id DESC) AS rn FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'AP') x WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY cust_id

questions.question: In each product category, which product has the second highest list price (break price ties by product name)? Show the category code, the product name and the list price, ordered by category code.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc FROM (SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC, prod_nm) AS rn FROM prod_catalog) x WHERE rn = 2 ORDER BY categ_cd

questions.question: For each month of 2026 that has orders, show the number of orders placed that month and the cumulative number of orders placed from January 2026 up to and including that month. Oldest month first.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ym, n, SUM(n) OVER (ORDER BY ym) FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY ym) t ORDER BY ym

questions.question: For each ticket that is not the first ticket its customer ever opened, how many hours passed since that customer's previous ticket was opened? Show the ticket id and the hours rounded to one decimal, ordered by ticket id, and only the first 5 rows.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT tkt_id, ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, prev_ts, opened_ts) / 60, 1) FROM (SELECT tkt_id, opened_ts, LAG(opened_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY opened_ts, tkt_id) AS prev_ts FROM support_tkt) x WHERE prev_ts IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tkt_id LIMIT 5

questions.question: Whose second order is the most valuable? Show the customer id and the total of that second order, ignoring currency, and break ties by customer id.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT cust_id, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT cust_id, ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) AS rn FROM ord_hdr) x WHERE rn = 2 ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, cust_id LIMIT 1

questions.question: Take the customers who have delivered orders and rank them by their total delivered order value, ignoring currency, highest first with ties broken by customer id. Split them into four equal groups with NTILE(4). Which customers are in the first group? Show their ids.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT cust_id FROM (SELECT cust_id, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ord_total_amt) DESC, cust_id) AS q FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' GROUP BY cust_id) x WHERE q = 1

questions.question: Of the customers who opened a ticket in September 2026, what percentage placed an order in October 2026? Round to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-09-01' AND opened_ts < '2026-10-01'), o AS (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-10-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-11-01') SELECT ROUND(100 * COUNT(o.cust_id) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM t LEFT JOIN o ON o.cust_id = t.cust_id

questions.question: For each warehouse, what was the net change in stock during 2026, adding all movements (restocks, shipments out as negative numbers, and adjustments)? Show the warehouse id and the net change.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(qty) FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY wh_id

questions.question: How many sessions ended in a purchase, and what is the average number of events in those sessions, rounded to one decimal? Show both numbers.
questions.gold_sql: WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE'), n AS (SELECT w.session_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM web_event w JOIN p ON p.session_id = w.session_id GROUP BY w.session_id) SELECT COUNT(*), ROUND(AVG(c), 1) FROM n

questions.question: Which product was added to a cart most often in sessions that never reached a purchase? Show the product name and the number of such cart events, breaking ties by product name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.prod_nm, COUNT(*) AS n FROM web_event w JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = w.sku WHERE w.evt_type = 'CART' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_event x WHERE x.session_id = w.session_id AND x.evt_type = 'PURCHASE') GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY n DESC, p.prod_nm LIMIT 1

questions.question: For each customer tier, what is the average number of orders per customer, counting customers who have no orders as zero? Show the tier code and the average rounded to two decimals.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT tier_cd, ROUND(AVG(n), 2) FROM (SELECT c.tier_cd, c.cust_id, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS n FROM cust_master c LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id GROUP BY c.tier_cd, c.cust_id) t GROUP BY tier_cd
questions.tests: average over a left join including zeros

questions.question: Among the months of 2026, which month had the biggest increase in the number of orders compared with the month before it? Show the year-month and the increase.
questions.gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-12-01' AND ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY ym), d AS (SELECT ym, n - LAG(n) OVER (ORDER BY ym) AS inc FROM m) SELECT ym, inc FROM d WHERE ym >= '2026-01' ORDER BY inc DESC, ym LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which products were viewed at least 100 times in the event log but were ordered in fewer than 10 units in total? Show the product names.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM web_event w WHERE w.sku = p.sku AND w.evt_type = 'VIEW') >= 100 AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.qty), 0) FROM ord_line l WHERE l.sku = p.sku) < 10

questions.question: Which customers opened a ticket after the date of their most recent order? Only customers who have at least one order count. Show the customer ids.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.cust_id FROM support_tkt t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = t.cust_id) AND DATE(t.opened_ts) > (SELECT MAX(o2.ord_dt) FROM ord_hdr o2 WHERE o2.cust_id = t.cust_id)

questions.question: Which customers placed at least one order in each of the three months July, August and September of 2026? Show the customer ids.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT MONTH(ord_dt)) = 3

questions.question: For each region, which customer placed the most recent order? Show the region code, the customer id and the order date. If two orders share the latest date in a region, keep the one with the higher order id. Order by region code.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT region_cd, cust_id, ord_dt FROM (SELECT c.region_cd, o.cust_id, o.ord_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.region_cd ORDER BY o.ord_dt DESC, o.ord_id DESC) AS rn FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id) x WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY region_cd
questions.tests: latest row per group with a tie rule

questions.question: For how many closed tickets was the CLOSE event recorded by the same employee who is assigned to the ticket?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt t WHERE t.closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tkt_event e WHERE e.tkt_id = t.tkt_id AND e.evt_type = 'CLOSE' AND e.actor_emp_id = t.assigned_emp_id)

questions.question: Which products are at or below their reorder point in at least two warehouses? Show the product names.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.prod_nm FROM inventory i JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = i.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm HAVING SUM(i.on_hand_qty <= i.reorder_pt) >= 2

questions.question: Which customers placed orders in both July 2026 and August 2026? Show the customer ids.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-08-01' INTERSECT SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-08-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-09-01'

questions.question: Which customers had an approved refund and also a denied refund? Show the customer ids.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT o.cust_id FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = r.ord_id WHERE r.status_cd = 'A' INTERSECT SELECT o.cust_id FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = r.ord_id WHERE r.status_cd = 'D'

questions.question: Which employees approved at least one refund but do not work in the Support department? Show the employee names.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.emp_nm FROM refund_req r JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = r.approver_emp_id WHERE e.dept_cd <> 'SUP'

questions.question: Which warehouses shipped fewer than 3 orders during October 2026, counting warehouses that shipped none? Show the warehouse ids.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT w.wh_id FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN shipment s ON s.wh_id = w.wh_id AND s.ship_dt >= '2026-10-01' AND s.ship_dt < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY w.wh_id HAVING COUNT(s.ship_id) < 3
questions.tests: left join keeps warehouses with zero rows

questions.question: Which customers have ordered a product in the kitchen category (KIT) but never a product in the office category (OFC)? Show the customer ids.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.cust_id FROM ord_hdr o JOIN ord_line l ON l.ord_id = o.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = l.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'KIT' AND o.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT o2.cust_id FROM ord_hdr o2 JOIN ord_line l2 ON l2.ord_id = o2.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p2 ON p2.sku = l2.sku WHERE p2.categ_cd = 'OFC')

questions.question: List the customers who placed an order in October 2026 but had no ticket opened in October 2026. Show the customer ids.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-10-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-11-01' EXCEPT SELECT cust_id FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-10-01' AND opened_ts < '2026-11-01'

questions.question: For each customer region, show the number of orders in each order status as five columns after the region code, in the order new, shipped, delivered, cancelled, returned.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.region_cd, SUM(o.ord_status = 'N'), SUM(o.ord_status = 'S'), SUM(o.ord_status = 'D'), SUM(o.ord_status = 'C'), SUM(o.ord_status = 'R') FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.region_cd

questions.question: For each ticket category, show the number of open tickets and the number of closed tickets as two columns after the category code.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT categ_cd, SUM(closed_ts IS NULL), SUM(closed_ts IS NOT NULL) FROM support_tkt GROUP BY categ_cd

questions.question: For each month of 2026, how many settled payments were made with each method? Show the year-month and four columns for CC, PP, BT and GC, oldest month first. Count payment attempts whose status is settled.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(method_cd = 'CC'), SUM(method_cd = 'PP'), SUM(method_cd = 'BT'), SUM(method_cd = 'GC') FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND paid_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

questions.question: For each carrier, how many delivered shipments arrived on time, meaning within 5 days of shipping, and how many arrived late? Show the carrier code and the two counts.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT carrier_cd, SUM(DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt) <= 5), SUM(DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt) > 5) FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' GROUP BY carrier_cd
questions.tests: two buckets from one date difference

questions.question: For each customer tier, how many customers have no orders, how many have 1 or 2 orders and how many have 3 or more orders? Show the tier code and the three counts.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT tier_cd, SUM(n = 0), SUM(n BETWEEN 1 AND 2), SUM(n >= 3) FROM (SELECT c.tier_cd, c.cust_id, COUNT(o.ord_id) AS n FROM cust_master c LEFT JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id GROUP BY c.tier_cd, c.cust_id) t GROUP BY tier_cd

questions.question: For each sales channel, what percentage of its orders used at least one promotion? Show the channel code and the percentage rounded to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT o.channel_cd, ROUND(100 * SUM(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_promo op WHERE op.ord_id = o.ord_id)) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM ord_hdr o GROUP BY o.channel_cd
questions.tests: rate with EXISTS inside an aggregate

questions.question: How many orders were placed on each day of the week? Show the day name and the count, ordered Monday first through Sunday last.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DAYNAME(ord_dt), COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY DAYNAME(ord_dt), WEEKDAY(ord_dt) ORDER BY WEEKDAY(ord_dt)

questions.question: How many tickets were opened outside business hours, meaning before 08:00, at or after 18:00, or on a Saturday or Sunday?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt WHERE HOUR(opened_ts) < 8 OR HOUR(opened_ts) >= 18 OR DAYOFWEEK(opened_ts) IN (1, 7)

questions.question: On average, how many minutes pass between a ticket being opened and its first ASSIGN event? Only tickets that have an ASSIGN event count. Round to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, t.opened_ts, a.first_assign)) / 60, 1) FROM support_tkt t JOIN (SELECT tkt_id, MIN(evt_ts) AS first_assign FROM tkt_event WHERE evt_type = 'ASSIGN' GROUP BY tkt_id) a ON a.tkt_id = t.tkt_id
questions.tests: min of a child table then a difference

questions.question: For each month, based on the ship date, what is the average number of days between the order date and the ship date of the shipments? Show the year-month and the average rounded to one decimal, oldest month first.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.ship_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(s.ship_dt, o.ord_dt)), 1) FROM shipment s JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = s.ord_id GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym
questions.tests: grouping by the date of one table, measuring against another

questions.question: How many browsing sessions lasted longer than 10 minutes, measured from the session's first event to its last event?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT session_id FROM web_event GROUP BY session_id HAVING TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, MIN(evt_ts), MAX(evt_ts)) > 10) t
questions.tests: session duration from the large table

questions.question: In which month did the most customers sign up? Show the year-month and the number of sign-ups, and break ties by the earlier month.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust_master GROUP BY ym ORDER BY n DESC, ym LIMIT 1

questions.question: A big spender is a customer whose delivered orders add up to at least 5000, ignoring currency differences. How many big spenders does each customer tier have? Show the tier code and the count, and include only tiers with at least one big spender.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.tier_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_master c JOIN (SELECT cust_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS tot FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' GROUP BY cust_id HAVING SUM(ord_total_amt) >= 5000) t ON t.cust_id = c.cust_id GROUP BY c.tier_cd
questions.tests: threshold on an aggregate, then group

questions.question: A fast order is one that was shipped no later than the day after it was placed (ship date minus order date is 0 or 1 days). How many fast orders did each carrier ship? Show the carrier code and the count, and include only carriers with at least one fast order.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT s.carrier_cd, COUNT(*) FROM shipment s JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = s.ord_id WHERE DATEDIFF(s.ship_dt, o.ord_dt) <= 1 GROUP BY s.carrier_cd

questions.question: A cart abandoner is a logged-in customer who added something to a cart in a session that had no purchase. How many distinct cart abandoners are there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.cust_id) FROM web_event w WHERE w.evt_type = 'CART' AND w.cust_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_event x WHERE x.session_id = w.session_id AND x.evt_type = 'PURCHASE')

questions.question: A slow-moving product is one that is still sold (not discontinued) and had fewer than 5 units ordered on orders dated in 2026. Which products are slow-moving? Show the product names, including products with no orders at all.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.sku, SUM(l.qty) AS u FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY l.sku) x ON x.sku = p.sku WHERE p.disc_flag = 0 AND COALESCE(x.u, 0) < 5

questions.question: A ticket is escalated when it has at least one ESCAL event. What percentage of the tickets with severity 1 or 2 were escalated? Round to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tkt_event e WHERE e.tkt_id = t.tkt_id AND e.evt_type = 'ESCAL')) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM support_tkt t WHERE t.sev_lvl IN (1, 2)

questions.question: The reorder gap of a stock row is its reorder point minus its quantity on hand, counted only when the quantity on hand is at or below the reorder point. Which warehouse has the largest total reorder gap? Show the warehouse id and the total gap.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(reorder_pt - on_hand_qty) AS gap FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY gap DESC, wh_id LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many different promotions have been applied to at least one order?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT promo_id) FROM ord_promo

questions.question: How many units of the product named 'Aurora Kettle' have been restocked in total, counting only restock movements?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(m.qty) FROM inv_move m JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = m.sku WHERE p.prod_nm = 'Aurora Kettle' AND m.mv_type = 'IN'
questions.tests: movement type, not the order lines

questions.question: Which payment method has the most settled payments? Show the method code and the number of settled payments.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT method_cd, COUNT(*) AS n FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY n DESC, method_cd LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many shipments left from a warehouse that serves a different region from the region of the customer who ordered?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment s JOIN warehouse w ON w.wh_id = s.wh_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = s.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE w.region_cd <> c.region_cd
questions.tests: two region columns on different tables

questions.question: How many customers were in the VIP segment in October 2026, according to the segment history?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-10-01' AND segment_cd = 'VIP'

questions.question: According to the event log, how many purchases were made through the app?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND channel_cd = 'APP'
questions.tests: event log, not the order channel
